# unifi_dashboard (Resource)

The `unifi_dashboard` resource manages a custom dashboard in the UniFi controller: a named, optionally public collection of modules. This is the internal-SDK dashboard entity and is distinct from `unifi_setting_dashboard`, which controls the built-in dashboard layout setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A custom dashboard composed of modules.
resource "unifi_dashboard" "ops" {
  name      = "Operations"
  desc      = "Key operational widgets"
  is_public = false

  modules = [
    {
      id           = "module-1"
      module_id    = "traffic-overview"
      config       = jsonencode({ range = "24h" })
      restrictions = ""
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `controller_version` (String) The controller version the dashboard was authored against.
- `desc` (String) A free-form description of the dashboard.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is publicly visible.
- `modules` (Attributes List) The modules that make up the dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modules))
- `name` (String) The name of the dashboard.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--modules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modules`

Optional:

- `config` (String) The module configuration payload (opaque JSON string).
- `id` (String) The identifier of the module instance on the dashboard.
- `module_id` (String) The identifier of the module type.
- `restrictions` (String) The module restrictions payload (opaque JSON string).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import from provider configured site
terraform import unifi_dashboard.ops 5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217

# import from another site
terraform import unifi_dashboard.ops another-site:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
